rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for a vehicle hijacking when the type of vehicle is not being specified.

example.english: The police said the hijack is still under investigation.
example.traditional: 警方話嗰宗劫持事件仲喺調查緊。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 waa6 go2 zung1 gip3 ci4 si6 gin2 zung6 hai2 diu6 caa4 gan2

rows.note: Use this specifically when the hijacked vehicle is an aircraft.

example.english: That hijack shocked the whole world.
example.traditional: 嗰宗劫機事件令全世界都好震驚。
example.jyutping: go2 zung1 gip3 gei1 si6 gin6 ling6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 hou2 zan3 ging1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for forcibly taking control of a vehicle, especially when the vehicle is not specifically an airplane.

example.english: The two armed men planned to hijack a truck and steal its cargo.
example.traditional: 兩名持刀男子計劃劫持一架貨車，搶走車上嘅貨物。
example.jyutping: loeng5 ming4 ci4 dou1 naam4 zi2 gai3 waak6 gip3 ci4 jat1 gaa3 fo3 ce1 coeng2 zau2 ce1 soeng6 ge3 fo3 mat6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the vehicle being hijacked is an airplane.

example.english: The terrorists tried to hijack a passenger plane and force it to fly to another country.
example.traditional: 恐怖分子企圖劫機，迫架客機飛去另一個國家。
example.jyutping: hung2 bou3 fan6 zi2 kei5 tou4 gip3 gei1 bik1 gaa3 haak3 gei1 fei1 heoi3 ling6 jat1 go3 gwok3 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for taking over a show, process, discussion, or resource and redirecting it toward your own purpose.

example.english: They were discussing travel plans, but someone tried to hijack the discussion and turn it into a rant about the government.
example.traditional: 佢哋本來傾緊旅遊安排，點知有人想騎劫個討論，將話題扯到鬧政府。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bun2 loi4 king1 gan2 leoi5 jau4 on1 paai4 dim2 zi1 jau5 jan4 soeng2 ke4 gip3 go3 tou2 leon6 zoeng1 waa6 tai4 ce2 dou3 naau6 zing3 fu2

rows.note: Use this for the takeover or redirection of a process, institution, discussion, or system rather than a vehicle.

example.english: Someone tried to turn the meeting into a hijack and send the discussion completely off topic.
example.traditional: 有人試圖將今次會議變成騎劫事件，令討論完全離題。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 si3 tou4 zoeng1 gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 bin3 sing4 ke4 gip3 si6 gin2 ling6 tou2 leon6 jyun4 cyun4 lei4 tai4
